scenario_spec.hypothesis: People may distinguish private reproductive choice from structural barriers such as housing, work culture, childcare cost, gender inequality, and job insecurity.

interventions.description: Low birth rate is framed primarily as an aggregate result of individual values and life choices.
Low birth rate is framed as a structural problem requiring stronger state intervention in housing, work, childcare, and gender equality.

scenario_spec.title: Low birth rate: individual choice or structural state problem
